provenance.method: Deterministic extraction of pinned bounded-search evidence; fresh replay of every displayed graph, algebra and fixed-representation operation minimum.

scope.search: Every labeled symmetric coloring, bottom iff diagonal; all selected sizes exhausted.
scope.classes: Vertex relabeling only; lattice colors are fixed.
scope.minima: minimum basic unary operation count on each fixed carrier with its exact saved threshold relations; other embeddings and higher-arity signatures excluded
scope.negative: M4 has no passing graph witness on carriers of size 1 through 4 in this search. Larger carriers are outside this result.
scope.verification: The displayed results are exhaustive Python computations on finite inputs. They do not prove the general graph criterion, Python/Lean equivalence, or mathematical novelty.
scope.failure_examples: Negative certificate wrappers are demo-generated from recorded search samples; they are excluded from the seven saved passing witnesses and do not change aggregate search counts.
scope.ranks: Longest cover-chain distance from the bottom, used only for layout; these values do not assert that a lattice is graded.
scope.encoding: Lattice elements and carrier vertices use zero-based indices. color[x][y] is a lattice element index; operation[x] is the image of vertex x. Equal partition entries identify an equivalence class.
scope.freshness: No timestamps or machine paths are emitted. --check replays displayed checks and compares every generated byte; it does not rerun the complete bounded search.

witness.origin: Saved passing witness; certificate copied byte for byte from pinned evidence.
